I've recently come across two Russian holograms. One of them was apparently made by a famous artist in Russia, though I have yet to validate that. Does anyone have any information on Russian holograms, have any history, know their value, etc? I would like to learn what I can about them before I decide to keep or sell.

The label reads as such:

Leningrad Factory of Artistic Glass

193019 Saint-Petersburg USSR

Professor Kachalov STR

Producer V. Brynskin

I've attached a few images for reference.

Thank for any help or guidance! 

SweetD
